metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'M365 - Mass SharePoint / OneDrive Download'

properties.description:
Detects users downloading > 200 files within 1 hour from SharePoint or OneDrive,
with comparison to the user's own 14-day baseline (mean + 3*stdev). Catches
insider data theft and post-compromise smash-and-grab exfiltration.
properties.query:
let abs_threshold = 200;
let excluded_users = dynamic([]);
let baseline =
  OfficeActivity
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1h))
  | where Operation in ("FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull")
  | summarize HourlyCount = count() by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
  | summarize MeanHourly = avg(HourlyCount), StdevHourly = stdev(HourlyCount) by UserId;
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in ("FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull")
| where UserId !in (excluded_users)
| summarize Downloads = count(), LastDownload = max(TimeGenerated),
            Files = make_set(OfficeObjectId, 50), IPs = make_set(ClientIP, 10)
          by UserId
| where Downloads >= abs_threshold
| join kind=leftouter baseline on UserId
| extend AnomalyScore = iff(StdevHourly > 0, (todouble(Downloads) - MeanHourly) / StdevHourly, 99.0)
| where AnomalyScore > 3.0 or isnull(MeanHourly)
| project TimeGenerated = LastDownload, UserId, Downloads, MeanHourly,
          StdevHourly, AnomalyScore, IPs, Files

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{UserId}} downloaded {{Downloads}} files in one hour, above its own 14-day baseline, from {{IPs}}.
